name: Milpitas Volunteer Program (teen-friendly roles)
org: City of Milpitas Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Join the city's volunteer list and pick from monthly emails: city events, park cleanups, community theater crew, tutoring teens at the Teen Center, or leading history activities at the Alviso Adobe.
who_can_apply: All ages. Volunteers under 14 need a parent or adult with them. Some jobs have their own rules. Volunteers 18 and older need fingerprint clearance for some jobs.
duration: Ongoing. Some jobs are one day, others are longer projects.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Volunteer Program Application (forms.milpitas.gov). Park cleanups do not need an application. Questions: 408-586-3210, volunteers@milpitas.gov.
notes: Alviso Adobe welcomes high school volunteers, but most tours are on weekdays during school hours. Teen Center tutoring is weekday afternoons, 4 to 7 pm. The page's special events and park cleanup lists look out of date (the last cleanup shown is from January 2024), so watch the monthly emails.
